title: Uniform excess bound
statement: Let $V$ be a finite nonempty set, let $p:V\to\mathbb{Q}$, and let $i\in V$. Then $p(i)-1/|V|$ is at most the maximum of $p(v)-1/|V|$ over $v\in V$.
